revisions.change_summary: Description of change: Replaces TMP1, TMP2, and TMP3-QM.SLQ009 in a single three-part document (Plan, Protocol, Final Report). Includes lean test group summary table, validation equivalence documentation, statistical rationale, results table, and separate approval actions for protocol and report. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 1 sub-issues 7 and 8; operationalizes QM.SLQ052 Rev A Section 13.
